use_case_name: Publish Subsurface Surveillance and Acoustic Contact Reports

claims.content: To exchange subsurface surveillance information and acoustic contact reports between JUs using the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message in accordance with Link 16 network requirements.

goal.raw_text: To exchange subsurface surveillance information and acoustic contact reports between JUs using the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message in accordance with Link 16 network requirements.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU is participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages on the Link 16 network.
The C2 JU has achieved Active status, or has returned to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
Sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration have been performed for air, surface, or land tracks (if applicable).
The minimum wait time before transmitting tracks has elapsed: 12 seconds for air and surface tracks, or 48 seconds for land tracks.
Subsurface surveillance track information is available and meets reporting criteria for exchange between JUs involved in joint operations.
Acoustic bearing/range data derived from ASW sensors is available for reporting via J5.4 message if applicable.
The C2 JU acquires subsurface surveillance track data or acoustic contact information that meets the reporting criteria for exchange between JUs involved in joint operations.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU acquires subsurface surveillance track data or acoustic contact information that meets the reporting criteria for exchange between JUs involved in joint operations.

claims.content: The C2 JU transmits surveillance information in Network PGs as defined for J3 Surveillance messages.
The C2 JU reports the geodetic latitude and longitude for each Subsurface surveillance track in the J3.4 message.
If available, the C2 JU specifies depth in the Subsurface surveillance reporting.
The C2 JU reports the velocity of Subsurface surveillance tracks as course and speed.
The speed is reported in data miles per hour of ground speed.
The course is reported in degrees with respect to true north.
The C2 JU exchanges Track identity using the Identity field.
Platform and Platform Activity may be reported in the J3.4I message to further amplify the identity of the reported track.
Discrete Identifier Codes (Special) are reported in the J7.5 message.
The time is set to the time contact was first acquired/time datum established, the time of current positional data, or the time contact was lost.
This time is reported in the Hour; Minute; and Time Function, ASW fields of the J3.4C1 word.
If Track Quality data is included in the report, the C2 JU must exclude it because Track quality is not applicable to Subsurface surveillance.

If the system detects potential overloading of the terminal-to-host interface or high TDS processor demands, the C2 JU may apply Message label/sublabel filters to inhibit specific messages from being forwarded to the Host TDS.
If data link overload conditions, system database overload, or undesired data entry risks are detected, the C2 JU may activate Data filters (transmit or receive filters) to inhibit the flow of data.
Subsurface surveillance track information has been exchanged between JUs using the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message.
Geodetic latitude and longitude for each Subsurface surveillance track have been reported in the J3.4 message.
Depth has been specified in the Subsurface surveillance reporting if available.
Velocity of Subsurface surveillance tracks has been reported as course and speed, with speed in data miles per hour of ground speed and course in degrees with respect to true north.
Track identity has been exchanged using the Identity field, with optional amplification via Platform and Platform Activity in the J3.4I message.
Discrete Identifier Codes (Special) have been reported in the J7.5 message in accordance with paragraph 4.7.6.5.
Time of contact acquisition, current positional data, or loss has been reported in the Hour; Minute; and Time Function, ASW fields of the J3.4C1 word.
Track quality data has not been included in the report, as it is not applicable to Subsurface surveillance.
